ko.title: 판결 이후의 관세: 비상 관세를 대체하는 제도와 면제 대상

segments.src: When the Supreme Court limited the use of emergency powers to impose sweeping tariffs, it did not end the U.S.
segments.tr: 대법원이 광범위한 관세를 부과하기 위한 비상 권한의 사용을 제한했다고 해서 미국의 관세 프로그램이 끝난 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: tariff program.
segments.tr: 관세 프로그램의 법적 기반이 변했을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: It changed the legal foundation underneath it.
With a temporary 10% global tariff now expired, the administration is leaning on a different set of statutes, and it is also granting exemptions for certain goods, including some from Canada.
segments.tr: 한시적인 10% 보편 관세가 만료됨에 따라 행정부는 다른 법률 조항들에 의존하고 있으며, 캐나다산 일부 제품을 포함한 특정 물품에 대해 면제 혜택도 부여하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the tools now in play, what each can and cannot do, and what importers and shoppers should watch.
segments.tr: 이 해설서에서는 현재 작용하고 있는 수단들, 각 수단이 할 수 있는 것과 할 수 없는 것, 그리고 수입업자와 소비자가 주시해야 할 사항들을 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not legal, trade or financial advice.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며 법률, 무역 또는 금융 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Tariff rules change often, so check official sources for current rates.*
segments.tr: 관세 규정은 자주 변경되므로 최신 세율은 공식 출처를 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **비상 권한 활용 경로가 좁아졌습니다.** 대법원의 판결로 광범위한 관세 부과의 근거로서 국제비상경제권한법(IEEPA)의 사용이 제한되었습니다.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **임시조치가 도입되었다가 만료되었습니다.** 가교 역할로 최대 10%의 한시적 보편 관세가 적용되었습니다. 이러한 조치는 자체 기한이 정해져 있으며, 이번 조치는 이제 만료되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **다른 법률 조항들이 대체하고 있습니다.** 관세는 조사, 결정 또는 특정 요건을 필요로 하는 권한 쪽으로 이동하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **면제 대상이 늘어나고 있습니다.** 특정 캐나다산 제품을 포함한 일부 물품이 예외로 적용되고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **환급 및 세부 규정은 아직 미정 상태입니다.** 이미 납부한 관세와 신규 조치에 관한 의문점들이 여전히 정부 기관과 법원에서 논의 중입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## 판결이 중요한 이유

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: IEEPA는 국가 비상사태 선포 시 대통령이 통상을 규제할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: 이 법은 여러 무역 상대국에 대해 광범위하고 신속하게 관세를 부과하는 정당화 근거로 사용되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: 법적 쟁점은 해당 법률의 "규제하다(regulate)"라는 단어에 헌법이 의회에 부여한 권한인 수입품에 과세할 수 있는 권한이 포함되는지 여부였습니다.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: 대법원은 이러한 해석을 제한함으로써 가장 신속한 수단을 제거하고 행정부가 더 많은 절차와 제한을 포함하는 법률을 따르도록 유도했습니다.

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## 가교 역할: 한시적 보편 관세

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: 1974년 무역법 제122조는 심각한 국제수지 문제를 해결하기 위해 한시적인 전면 수입 부가금을 허용합니다.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: 두 가지 특징이 이를 정의합니다:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **세율 상한.** 부가금은 15%를 초과할 수 없으며, 행정부는 10% 세율을 적용했습니다.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **시간 제한.** 의회가 연장을 의결하지 않는 한 150일 동안 지속됩니다.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: 이 수단은 단기용으로 설계되었기 때문에 영구적인 해법이라기보다는 가교 역할을 했습니다.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: 이 조치의 만료로 인해 아래의 대체 수단들에 관심이 쏠리게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## 프로그램을 이끌어가는 현재의 수단들

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### 제232조: 국가 안보

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: 1962년 무역확대법 제232조는 특정 제품의 수입이 국가 안보를 위협하는지 상무부가 조사할 수 있도록 합니다.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: 위협이 확인되면 대통령은 해당 제품에 관세를 부과할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: 철강, 알루미늄, 자동차는 오랜 기간 대상이 되어 왔으며, 다른 분야들도 조사를 받았습니다.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: 법원은 대체로 이 법에 따라 행정부에 광범위한 재량을 인정해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: 이 수단의 한계는 국가 전체에 대한 포괄적 관세가 아니라 조사를 거쳐 제품별로 적용된다는 점입니다.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### 제301조: 불공정 무역 행위

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: 1974년 무역법 제301조는 미국

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: 무역대표부(USTR)가 외국 국가의 무역 행위를 조사하고 관세로 대응할 수 있도록 합니다.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: 이는 많은 중국산 제품에 부과되어 있는 기존 관세의 근거가 됩니다.

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: 조사 결과 발표, 공공 의견 수렴, 청문회를 포함한 절차가 필요하므로 비상 조치보다는 느리지만, 법원에서 방어하기가 더 용이합니다.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: 신규 또는 확대된 국가 단위 조사는 행정부가 더 광범위한 관세 적용 범위를 재구축할 수 있는 한 가지 방법입니다.

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### 제201조: 세이프가드(긴급수입제한조치)

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: 제201조는 수입 급증으로 인해 국내 산업이 심각한 피해를 입었을 때 한시적인 구제를 허용합니다.

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: 국제무역위원회(ITC)의 판정이 필요하며 기간이 제한되어 있습니다.

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: 빈번하게 사용되지는 않았지만 여전히 유효한 수단입니다.

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### 제338조: 드물게 사용되는 옵션

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: 1930년 관세법 제338조는 미국 통상을

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: 차별하는 것으로 판명된 국가에 대해 추가 관세를 허용합니다.

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: 지속적으로 사용된 적이 없으며, 적용 범위와 법적 지속 가능성도 검증되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이를 확립된 경로가 아닌 하나의 가능성으로만 주로 논의합니다.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### 의회

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: 의회는 한시적 부가금 연장을 포함하여 관세를 직접 설정하거나 연장할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: 이는 법적으로 가장 확실한 경로지만 정치적으로 가장 어렵기 때문에, 행정부는 자체 권한을 선호해 왔습니다.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## 면제 대상 및 면제가 확대되는 이유

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: 면제는 관세 정책의 일반적인 특징입니다.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: 면제는 보통 관세 부과로 인해 정부가 가격 충격으로부터 보호하고자 하는 소비자나 산업의 비용이 상승할 때 도입되는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: 현재 적용 중인 예외 조치는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **특정 캐나다산 제품.** 특히 자동차, 에너지, 농업 부문에서 양국 간에 깊이 통합된 공급망을 반영하여 캐나다산 일부 제품이 면제되고 있습니다. 미국·메시코·캐나다 협정(USMCA) 요건을 충족하는 물품은 이전 라운드에서도 특별 처리를 받았습니다.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **품목별 제외.** 일부 에너지 제품, 의약품, 특정 핵심 투입재와 같은 품목은 과거 관세 조치에서 다르게 취급되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **절차 기반 제외.** 일부 프로그램에서는 다른 곳에서 수급이 불가능함을 증명할 경우 수입업자가 특정 제품에 대한 제외를 요청할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: 면제 목록은 공식 고시를 통해 발표되며 빠르게 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: 정확한 제품 코드와 조건이 매우 중요하므로, 제품의 관세 분류(HS 코드)를 확인하는 것이 가장 먼저 해야 할 일입니다.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## 향후 변경될 수 있는 사항

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **신규 조사.** 각 제232조 또는 제301조 조사를 통해 특정 제품이나 국가에 대한 관세가 추가되거나 조정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **이미 납부한 관세의 환급.** 비상 권한에 따라 관세를 납부한 수입업자들은 환급이 어떻게, 언제 처리될지 문의하고 있습니다. 시기와 절차는 법원 명령과 당국의 지침에 따라 달라지며, 모든 수입업자에게 결과가 보장되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **추가 소송.** 대체 권한에 대한 이의 제기가 가능하지만, 법원은 역사적으로 국가 안보 관련 관세에 대해 더 존중하는 태도를 취해 왔습니다.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **무역 협정.** 무역 상대국과의 협상된 협정은 세율을 낮추거나 상한을 설정할 수 있으며, 면제되는 물품을 결정지을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **의회 조치.** 입법을 통해 현재의 접근 방식을 승인, 제한 또는 대체할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## 수입업자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **각 선적 건의 법적 근거를 확인하십시오.** 이제 관세는 단일한 국가별 일률 세율보다 제품과 적용 법률 조항에 더 많이 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **관세 분류 및 원산지를 재검토하십시오.** 면제 및 세율은 정확한 분류 코드와 원산지에 따라 달라지는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **환급 자격을 추적하십시오.** 비상 권한에 따라 납부한 모든 관세에 대한 수입 신고 기록, 납부 증빙 및 기한을 보관하십시오.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **변동성에 대비하십시오.** 가격 조정을 허용하거나 관세 리스크를 분담하는 계약을 통해 갑작스러운 변화에 대한 노출을 줄이십시오.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. 재무적 영향이 큰 결정을 내릴 때는 **관세사나 무역 전문 변호사와 상담하십시오**.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## 소비자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: 관세는 수입업자가 납부하는 세금이며, 그 비용의 일부는 가격에 전가되는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: 전가되는 정도는 제품, 시장에서의 경쟁, 기업이 비용을 흡수할 수 있는 기간에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 점은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **가격이 한꺼번에 움직이지 않을 수 있습니다.** 소매업체들은 이전에 구매한 재고를 보유하고 있는 경우가 많아 시차를 두고 변화가 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **영향은 품목별로 다릅니다.** 수입 의존도가 높고 국내 대체재가 적은 제품일수록 더 민감하게 반응하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **면제 조치는 충격을 완화할 수 있습니다.** 예외가 적용되는 제품의 경우 충격이 완화될 수 있지만, 해당 카테고리의 모든 품목이 자격을 갖추는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인 주장에 주의하십시오.** 언론 보도는 최고 세율을 인용하는 경우가 많은 반면, 실제 납부 금액은 제품, 원산지, 면제 여부에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: 이번 판결로 하나의 법적 경로는 닫혔지만 관세가 끝난 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: 관세 프로그램은 신속하고 광범위한 비상 조치에서 조사와 법적 결정에 근거한 더 더디고 표적화된 수단으로 이동하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: 기업과 소비자에게 나타나는 실질적인 결과는 복잡성의 증가입니다. 세율과 면제가 특정 제품 및 원산지에 따라 달라지며, 신규 조사, 법원 판결, 무역 협상을 통해 정책 환경이 언제든 변할 수 있습니다.

zh.title: 裁决后的关税：什么将替代紧急关税，以及谁可享有豁免

segments.src: When the Supreme Court limited the use of emergency powers to impose sweeping tariffs, it did not end the U.S.
segments.tr: 当最高法院限制使用紧急权力来征收全面关税时，这并不意味着美国关税计划的终结。

segments.src: tariff program.
segments.tr: 关税计划。

segments.src: It changed the legal foundation underneath it.
segments.tr: 它改变了关税背后的法律基础。

segments.src: With a temporary 10% global tariff now expired, the administration is leaning on a different set of statutes, and it is also granting exemptions for certain goods, including some from Canada.
segments.tr: 随着为期暂定的 10% 全球关税现已到期，政府正在转向使用另一套法规，同时也在为某些货物（包括部分来自加拿大的货物）提供关税豁免。

segments.src: This explainer walks through the tools now in play, what each can and cannot do, and what importers and shoppers should watch.
segments.tr: 本篇解释性文章梳理了目前正在发挥作用的工具、每项工具的能与不能，以及进口商和消费者应当关注的事项。

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not legal, trade or financial advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成法律、贸易或财务建议。

segments.src: Tariff rules change often, so check official sources for current rates.*
segments.tr: 关税规定经常变动，请查阅官方来源以获取当前税率。*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 简要总结

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **紧急权力途径被收窄。** 最高法院的裁决限制了将《国际紧急经济权力法》（IEEPA）作为征收广泛关税的依据。

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **权宜之计已成为过去。** 最高可达 10% 的临时全球关税曾被用作过渡手段。此类措施自带时间限制，而该措施现已失效。

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **其他法规正在接管。** 关税政策正在转向需要调查、裁决结论或特定条件的授权依据。

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **豁免范围正在扩大。** 部分货物（包括某些加拿大产品）正被列入豁免名单。

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **退税与细则仍未敲定。** 关于已缴纳关税以及新措施的相关问题仍处于行政机构和法院的处理流程中。

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## 为什么这项裁决至关重要

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: IEEPA 允许总统在宣布的国家紧急状态期间对商业活动进行监管。

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: 它曾被用来证明针对许多贸易伙伴快速征收广泛关税具有合理性。

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: 法律争议的核心在于，该法律中的“监管（regulate）”一词是否包含对进口商品征税的权力，而宪法赋予了国会这项权力。

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: 通过限制这一解释，法院剥离了最快捷的工具，并推动行政部门转向包含更多程序和更多限制的法律。

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## 过渡桥梁：临时全球关税

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: 1974 年《贸易法》第 122 条允许加征临时的全面进口附加费，以解决严重的国际收支平衡问题。

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: 它具有两大特点：

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **税率上限。** 附加费不得超过 15%，而政府使用了 10% 的税率。

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **时间限制。** 除非国会投票决定延长，否则持续时间为 150 天。

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: 由于该工具旨在短期使用，因此它充当的是过渡桥梁而非永久解决方案。

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: 它的到期正是人们将注意力转向以下替代方案的原因。

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## 目前支撑该计划的工具

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### 第 232 条：国家安全

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: 1962 年《贸易拓展法》第 232 条允许商务部调查某种产品的进口是否威胁国家安全。

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: 如果认定存在威胁，总统可以对该产品加征关税。

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: 钢铁、铝和汽车长期以来一直包含在内，其他行业也接受过调查。

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: 法院在该法律下通常给予行政部门自由裁量空间。

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: 它的局限性在于，它是在调查之后按产品逐一施行，而不是实施覆盖全国家范围的全面关税。

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### 第 301 条：不公平贸易行为

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: 1974 年《贸易法》第 301 条允许美国

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: 贸易代表调查外国的做法并采取关税手段作为回应。

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: 它是对许多中国商品现行加征关税的法律基础。

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: 它需要包含裁决结论、公众评论和听证会在内的法定程序，因此比紧急行动慢，但在法庭上更具可辩护性。

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: 开展新的或扩大的国家级调查是政府重建更广泛关税覆盖范围的一种方式。

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### 第 201 条：保障措施

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: 第 201 条允许在进口激增严重损害国内产业时提供临时救济。

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: 它需要美国

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: 国际贸易委员会做出调查裁定，且在时间上受到限制。

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: 它的使用频率要低得多，但依然是一项可选工具。

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### 第 338 条：一项极少使用的选项

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: 1930 年《关税法》第 338 条允许对被认定歧视美国

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: 商业的国家加征额外关税。

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: 它从未被持续使用过，其适用范围和法律持久性未经考验。

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: 分析人士主要将其作为一种可能性而非成熟途径来讨论。

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### 国会

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: 国会可以直接设定或延长关税，包括延长临时附加费。

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: 这是法律上最稳固的途径，但在政治上也是最难的，这就是行政部门一直倾向于使用自身授权的原因。

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## 谁可享有豁免，以及为什么豁免范围在扩大

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: 豁免是关税政策的常见特征。

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: 当关税会增加政府希望免受价格冲击影响的消费者或行业的成本时，往往会出现豁免。

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: 目前的豁免情形包括：

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **某些加拿大货物。** 来自加拿大的部分产品被予以豁免，这反映了两国之间高度融合的供应链，特别是在汽车、能源和农业领域。符合《美墨加协定》（USMCA）条件 Goods 在先前的几轮关税中获得了特殊对待。

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **针对特定产品的排除。** 诸如部分能源产品、医药产品以及某些关键投入品等项目，在过往的关税行动中得到了区别对待。

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **基于程序的排除。** 部分计划允许进口商在能够证明无法从其他地方获得供应时，申请对特定产品进行排除。

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: 豁免清单在官方公告中发布，并可能迅速变化。

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: 确切的产品代码和条件至关重要，因此核实产品的海关归类是第一件要做的事。

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## 仍可能发生哪些变化

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **新的调查。** 每项 Section 232 或 301 案件都可能针对特定产品或国家增加或调整关税。

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **已缴纳关税的退款。** 在紧急权力下缴纳关税的进口商正在询问退款将如何以及何时处理。时间节点和具体程序取决于法院命令和机构指导，且并非每家进口商的结果都有保证。

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **进一步的诉讼。** 对替代授权依据发起挑战是有可能的，不过法院在历史上对涉及国家安全的关税态度更为顺从。

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **贸易协定。** 与合作伙伴协商达成的协议可以降低或封顶税率，并能塑造哪些货物可以免税。

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **国会行动。** 立法可能会确认、限制或替代现有的应对路线。

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## 这对进口商意味着什么

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **确认每批货物的法律依据。** 现在的关税更多取决于具体产品和法规依据，而不是统一的全国家税率。

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **审查关税归类和原产地。** 豁免和税率通常取决于精确的归类代码和原产国。

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **跟踪退税资格。** 妥善保存根据紧急权力缴纳的任何关税的报关记录、付款凭证及截止日期。

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **为波动做好规划。** 允许价格调整或分担关税风险的合同可以减少面临突发的风险敞口。

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **咨询持牌报关师或贸易律师** 以应对涉及重大财务利益的决策。

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## 这对消费者意味着什么

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: 关税是由进口商缴纳的税款，其中一部分成本往往会转嫁到商品价格中。

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: 转嫁多少取决于产品、市场竞争以及企业能在多长时间内吸收成本。

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: 以下是几点实用建议：

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **价格可能不会一下子变动。** 零售商通常保有早期购买的库存，因此价格变化可能会滞后显现。

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **不同品类的影响有所不同。** 大量依赖进口且国内替代品较少的商品往往更为敏感。

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **豁免可以缓和冲击** 对于属于豁免范围的产品而言，但并非某个品类下的每件商品都符合条件。

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **对待宣传口径需谨慎。** 新闻头条往往引用最高税率，而实际缴纳的金额取决于具体产品、原产地和豁免情况。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: 该裁决关闭了一条法律途径，但并未终结关税。

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: 关税计划正从快速、广泛的紧急措施，转向基于调查和法定裁决结论的更慢、更具针对性的工具。

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: 对企业和消费者而言，实际结果是复杂性增加：税率和豁免取决于特定产品及其原产地，且政策格局仍可能因新的调查、法院判决和贸易谈判发生改变。

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## संक्षेप में

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **आपातकालीन-शक्तियों के मार्ग को संकुचित कर दिया गया।** कोर्ट के फैसले ने व्यापक टैरिफ के आधार के रूप में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आपातकालीन आर्थिक शक्ति अधिनियम (IEEPA) के उपयोग को सीमित कर दिया।

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **एक अस्थायी व्यवस्था आई और चली गई।** 10% तक का एक अस्थायी वैश्विक टैरिफ एक सेतु के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया गया था। ऐसे उपायों में एक अंतर्निहित समय सीमा होती है, और यह अब समाप्त हो गई है।

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **अन्य कानून जगह ले रहे हैं।** टैरिफ उन अधिकारियों की ओर स्थानांतरित हो रहे हैं जिन्हें जांच, निष्कर्ष या विशिष्ट शर्तों की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **छूट बढ़ रही है।** कुछ सामानों को बाहर रखा जा रहा है, जिसमें कुछ कनाडाई उत्पाद भी शामिल हैं।

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **रिफंड और नियम अनिर्णीत बने हुए हैं।** पहले ही भुगतान किए जा चुके शुल्कों और नए उपायों के बारे में सवाल अभी भी एजेंसियों और अदालतों के माध्यम से आगे बढ़ रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## फैसला क्यों महत्वपूर्ण था

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: IEEPA एक राष्ट्रपति को घोषित राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान वाणिज्य को विनियमित करने की अनुमति देता है।

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: इसका उपयोग कई व्यापारिक भागीदारों पर व्यापक, तेजी से बदलते टैरिफ को सही ठहराने के लिए किया गया था।

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: कानूनी विवाद इस बात पर केंद्रित था कि क्या उस कानून में "विनियमित (regulate)" शब्द में आयात पर कर लगाने की शक्ति शामिल है, जो शक्ति संविधान कांग्रेस को देता है।

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: उस व्याख्या को सीमित करके, कोर्ट ने सबसे तेज़ उपकरण को हटा दिया और कार्यकारी शाखा को उन कानूनों की ओर धकेल दिया जिनमें अधिक प्रक्रिया और अधिक सीमाएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## सेतु: एक अस्थायी वैश्विक टैरिफ

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: 1974 के व्यापार अधिनियम की धारा 122 गंभीर भुगतान संतुलन समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए एक अस्थायी व्यापक आयात अधिभार की अनुमति देती है।

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: दो विशेषताएं इसे परिभाषित करती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **एक दर सीमा।** अधिभार 15% से अधिक नहीं हो सकता है, और प्रशासन ने 10% दर का उपयोग किया।

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **एक समय सीमा।** यह 150 दिनों तक रहता है जब तक कि कांग्रेस इसे बढ़ाने के लिए मतदान न करे।

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: क्योंकि यह उपकरण अल्पकालिक होने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है, इसने एक स्थायी उत्तर के बजाय एक सेतु के रूप में काम किया।

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: इसकी समाप्ति का कारण यह है कि ध्यान नीचे दिए गए प्रतिस्थापनों की ओर मुड़ गया है।

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## कार्यक्रम को आगे बढ़ाने वाले उपकरण

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### धारा 232: राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: 1962 के व्यापार विस्तार अधिनियम की धारा 232 वाणिज्य विभाग को यह जांच करने की अनुमति देती है कि क्या किसी उत्पाद का आयात राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा के लिए खतरा है।

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: यदि इसे कोई खतरा मिलता है, तो राष्ट्रपति उस उत्पाद पर टैरिफ लगा सकते हैं।

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: स्टील, एल्यूमीनियम और ऑटो लंबे समय से शामिल रहे हैं, और अन्य क्षेत्रों की जांच की गई है।

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: अदालतों ने आम तौर पर इस कानून के तहत कार्यकारी शाखा को व्यापक गुंजाइश दी है।

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: इसकी सीमा यह है कि यह एक पूरे देश के व्यापक टैरिफ के रूप में नहीं, बल्कि जांच के बाद उत्पाद दर उत्पाद काम करता है।

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### धारा 301: अनुचित व्यापार प्रथाएं

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: 1974 के व्यापार अधिनियम की धारा 301 अमेरिका के

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: व्यापार प्रतिनिधि को किसी विदेशी देश की प्रथाओं की जांच करने और टैरिफ के साथ जवाब देने की अनुमति देती है।

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: यह कई चीनी सामानों पर मौजूदा शुल्कों को रेखांकित करता है।

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: इसके लिए एक प्रक्रिया की आवश्यकता होती है जिसमें निष्कर्ष, सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी और सुनवाई शामिल होती है, इसलिए यह आपातकालीन कार्रवाई की तुलना में धीमी है, लेकिन यह अदालत में अधिक बचाव योग्य है।

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: नए या विस्तारित देश-स्तरीय जांच एक तरीका है जिससे प्रशासन व्यापक कवरेज का पुनर्निर्माण कर सकता है।

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### धारा 201: सुरक्षा उपाय

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: धारा 201 अस्थायी राहत की अनुमति देती है जब आयात में उछाल घरेलू उद्योग को गंभीर रूप से नुकसान पहुंचाता है।

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: इसके लिए अमेरिकी

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार आयोग द्वारा निष्कर्ष की आवश्यकता होती है और इसकी अवधि सीमित होती है।

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: इसका उपयोग बहुत कम बार किया गया है, लेकिन यह उपलब्ध है।

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### धारा 338: शायद ही कभी इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला विकल्प

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: 1930 के टैरिफ अधिनियम की धारा 338 उन देशों पर अतिरिक्त शुल्क की अनुमति देती है जो अमेरिकी

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: वाणिज्य के खिलाफ भेदभाव करते पाए जाते हैं।

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: इसका उपयोग कभी भी निरंतर तरीके से नहीं किया गया है, और इसका दायरा और कानूनी स्थायित्व अप्रमाणित है।

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक मुख्य रूप से एक संभावना के रूप में इस पर चर्चा करते हैं, न कि एक स्थापित मार्ग के रूप में।

segments.src: ### Congress
Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस सीधे टैरिफ निर्धारित या बढ़ा सकती है, जिसमें अस्थायी अधिभार बढ़ाना भी शामिल है।

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: यह कानूनी रूप से सबसे सुरक्षित मार्ग है लेकिन राजनीतिक रूप से सबसे कठिन है, यही वजह है कि कार्यकारी शाखा ने अपने स्वयं के अधिकारों का समर्थन किया है।

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## किसे छूट प्राप्त है, और छूट क्यों बढ़ रही है

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: छूट टैरिफ नीति की एक सामान्य विशेषता है।

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: वे तब दिखाई देते हैं जब शुल्क उन उपभोक्ताओं या उद्योगों के लिए लागत बढ़ाते हैं जिन्हें सरकार मूल्य के झटकों से बचाना चाहती है।

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: वर्तमान छूटों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **कुछ कनाडाई सामान।** कनाडा के कुछ उत्पादों को छूट दी जा रही है, जो दोनों देशों के बीच गहराई से एकीकृत आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को दर्शाता है, विशेष रूप से ऑटो, ऊर्जा और कृषि में। अमेरिका-मेक्सिको-कनाडा समझौते (USMCA) के तहत अर्हता प्राप्त करने वाले सामानों को पहले के दौरों में विशेष व्यवहार मिला है।

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **उत्पाद-विशिष्ट बहिष्करण।** कुछ ऊर्जा उत्पादों, फार्मास्यूटिकल्स और कुछ महत्वपूर्ण इनपुट जैसी वस्तुओं के साथ पिछले टैरिफ कार्यों में अलग व्यवहार किया गया है।

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **प्रक्रिया-आधारित बहिष्करण।** कुछ कार्यक्रम आयातकों को विशिष्ट उत्पादों के लिए बहिष्करण का अनुरोध करने की अनुमति देते हैं जब वे दिखा सकते हैं कि आपूर्ति कहीं और उपलब्ध नहीं है।

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: छूट की सूचियां आधिकारिक नोटिसों में प्रकाशित की जाती हैं और जल्दी बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: सटीक उत्पाद कोड और स्थितियां बहुत मायने रखती हैं, इसलिए किसी उत्पाद का टैरिफ वर्गीकरण पहली चीज है जिसकी पुष्टि की जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## अभी भी क्या बदल सकता है

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **नई जांच।** प्रत्येक धारा 232 या 301 का मामला विशिष्ट उत्पादों या देशों पर शुल्क जोड़ या समायोजित कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **पहले ही भुगतान किए गए शुल्कों के लिए रिफंड।** जिन आयातकों ने आपातकालीन प्राधिकरण के तहत शुल्क का भुगतान किया था, वे पूछ रहे हैं कि रिफंड की प्रक्रिया कैसे और कब की जाएगी। समय और प्रक्रिया अदालती आदेशों और एजेंसी के मार्गदर्शन पर निर्भर करती है, और परिणाम हर आयातकों के लिए गारंटीकृत नहीं है।

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **आगे की मुकदमेबाजी।** प्रतिस्थापन प्राधिकारियों को चुनौतियां संभव हैं, हालांकि अदालतों ने ऐतिहासिक रूप से राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा टैरिफ पर अधिक सम्मान दिखाया है।

segments.tr: - **La vía de los poderes de emergencia se redujo.** La decisión de la Corte limitó el uso de la Ley de Poderes Económicos de Emergencia Internacional (IEEPA, por sus siglas en inglés) como base para aranceles amplios.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## النسخة المختصرة

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **تم تضييق مسار سلطات الطوارئ.** قيد قرار المحكمة استخدام قانون السلطات الاقتصادية الطارئة الدولية (IEEPA) كأساس لفرض تعريفات جمركية واسعة النطاق.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **جاء إجراء مؤقت ثم انتهى.** تم استخدام تعريفة عالمية مؤقتة تصل إلى 10% كجسر. تحمل مثل هذه التدابير حدًا زمنيًا مدمجًا، وقد انقضت صلاحية هذا الإجراء الآن.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **قوانين أخرى تتولى المهمة.** تتحول التعريفات الجمركية نحو سلطات تتطلب تحقيقات أو نتائج أو شروطًا محددة.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **الإعفاءات في تزايد.** يتم استثناء بعض السلع، بما في ذلك منتجات كندية معينة.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **الاستردادات والقواعد لا تزال غير مستقرة.** لا تزال الأسئلة حول الرسوم المدفوعة بالفعل، وحول التدابير الجديدة، قيد المراجعة من قبل الوكالات والمحاكم.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## لماذا كان الحكم مهمًا

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: يسمح قانون IEEPA للرئيس بتنظيم التجارة خلال حالة طوارئ وطنية معلنة.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: وقد استُخدم لتبرير تعريفات جمركية واسعة وسريعة التنفيذ على العديد من الشركاء التجاريين.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: تمحور النزاع القانوني حول ما إذا كانت كلمة "تنظيم" في ذلك القانون تتضمن سلطة فرض ضرائب على الواردات، وهي سلطة يمنحها الدستور للكونغرس.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: من خلال تقييد هذا التفسير، أزالت المحكمة الأداة الأسرع ودفعت السلطة التنفيذية نحو قوانين تتضمن المزيد من الإجراءات والمزيد من القيود.

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## الجسر: تعريفة عالمية مؤقتة

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: يسمح القسم 122 من قانون التجارة لعام 1974 بفرض رسوم إضافية مؤقتة شاملة على الواردات لمعالجة مشاكل ميزان المدفوعات الخطيرة.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: تحددها ميزتان:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **سقف السعر.** لا يمكن أن تتجاوز الرسوم الإضافية 15%، وقد استخدمت الإدارة معدل 10%.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **حد زمني.** تستمر لمدة 150 يومًا ما لم يصوت الكونغرس على تمديدها.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن هذه الأداة مصممة لتكون قصيرة الأجل، فقد عملت كجسر بدلاً من كونها حلاً دائمًا.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: انتهاء صلاحيتها هو السبب في تحول الانتباه إلى البدائل أدناه.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## الأدوات التي تدعم البرنامج الآن

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### القسم 232: الأمن القومي

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: يسمح القسم 232 من قانون توسيع التجارة لعام 1962 لوزارة التجارة بالتحقيق فيما إذا كانت واردات منتج ما تهدد الأمن القومي.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: إذا وجدت تهديدًا، يمكن للرئيس فرض تعريفات جمركية على ذلك المنتج.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: لطالما تمت تغطية الصلب والألمنيوم والسيارات، وتم فحص قطاعات أخرى.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: منحت المحاكم عمومًا السلطة التنفيذية مساحة واسعة بموجب هذا القانون.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: قيوده تكمن في أنه يعمل منتجًا تلو الآخر، بعد إجراء تحقيق، بدلاً من كونه تعريفة شاملة على مستوى البلاد.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### القسم 301: الممارسات التجارية غير العادلة

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: يسمح القسم 301 من قانون التجارة لعام 1974 لـ

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: الممثل التجاري بالتحقيق في ممارسات دولة أجنبية والرد عليها بتعريفات جمركية.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: وهو يدعم الرسوم الحالية على العديد من السلع الصينية.

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: يتطلب عملية تتضمن نتائج وتعليقات عامة وجلسات استماع، لذا فهو أبطأ من إجراءات الطوارئ، لكنه أكثر قابلية للدفاع عنه في المحكمة.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: التحقيقات الجديدة أو الموسعة على مستوى الدولة هي إحدى الطرق التي يمكن للإدارة من خلالها إعادة بناء تغطية أوسع.

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### القسم 201: الضمانات

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: يسمح القسم 201 بإغاثة مؤقتة عندما تؤدي زيادة الواردات إلى إلحاق ضرر جسيم بصناعة محلية.

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: يتطلب نتيجة من قبل

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: لجنة التجارة الدولية الأمريكية ومحدود المدة.

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: لقد تم استخدامه بشكل أقل بكثير، لكنه يظل متاحًا.

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### القسم 338: خيار نادر الاستخدام

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: يسمح القسم 338 من قانون التعريفة الجمركية لعام 1930 بفرض رسوم إضافية على الدول التي يثبت تمييزها ضد

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: التجارة الأمريكية.

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: لم يتم استخدامه أبدًا بطريقة مستمرة، ونطاقه ومتانته القانونية غير مختبرة.

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: يناقشه المحللون بشكل أساسي كإمكانية، وليس كمسار ثابت.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### الكونغرس

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: يمكن للكونغرس تحديد أو تمديد التعريفات الجمركية مباشرة، بما في ذلك تمديد الرسوم الإضافية المؤقتة.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: هذا هو المسار الأكثر أمانًا من الناحية القانونية ولكنه الأصعب سياسيًا، ولهذا السبب فضلت السلطة التنفيذية سلطاتها الخاصة.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## من المعفى، ولماذا تتوسع الإعفاءات

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: الإعفاءات هي سمة طبيعية لسياسة التعريفة الجمركية.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: تميل إلى الظهور عندما ترفع الرسوم التكاليف على المستهلكين أو الصناعات التي تريد الحكومة حمايتها من صدمات الأسعار.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: تشمل الاستثناءات الحالية:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **سلع كندية معينة.** يتم إعفاء بعض المنتجات من كندا، مما يعكس سلاسل التوريد المتكاملة بعمق بين البلدين، وخاصة في السيارات والطاقة والزراعة. السلع التي تستوفي الشروط بموجب اتفاقية الولايات المتحدة والمكسيك وكندا (USMCA) تلقت معاملة خاصة في جولات سابقة.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **استثناءات خاصة بالمنتجات.** تم التعامل مع عناصر مثل بعض منتجات الطاقة والأدوية وبعض المدخلات الحيوية بشكل مختلف في إجراءات التعريفة الجمركية السابقة.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **استثناءات قائمة على العملية.** تسمح بعض البرامج للمستوردين بطلب استثناءات لمنتجات محددة عندما يمكنهم إثبات أن العرض غير متاح في مكان آخر.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: يتم نشر قوائم الإعفاء في إشعارات رسمية ويمكن أن تتغير بسرعة.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: رموز المنتجات الدقيقة والشروط مهمة للغاية، لذا فإن تصنيف التعريفة الجمركية للمنتج هو أول شيء يجب التحقق منه.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## ما الذي قد يتغير أيضًا

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **تحقيقات جديدة.** يمكن لكل قضية بموجب القسم 232 أو 301 إضافة أو تعديل الرسوم على منتجات أو دول محددة.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **استرداد الرسوم المدفوعة بالفعل.** يسأل المستوردون الذين دفعوا رسومًا بموجب سلطة الطوارئ عن كيفية وموعد معالجة المبالغ المستردة. يعتمد التوقيت والإجراء على أوامر المحكمة وتوجيهات الوكالة، والنتيجة ليست مضمونة لكل مستورد.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **مزيد من التقاضي.** الطعون ضد سلطات الاستبدال ممكنة، على الرغم من أن المحاكم كانت تاريخيًا أكثر احترامًا لتعريفات الأمن القومي.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **اتفاقيات تجارية.** يمكن للاتفاقيات المتفاوض عليها مع الشركاء خفض أو تحديد الأسعار، ويمكن أن تشكل السلع المعفاة.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **إجراءات الكونغرس.** يمكن للتشريعات تأكيد أو تقييد أو استبدال النهج الحالي.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمستوردين

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **تأكيد الأساس القانوني لكل شحنة.** تعتمد الرسوم الآن بشكل أكبر على المنتج والقانون بدلاً من معدل واحد على مستوى البلاد.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **مراجعة تصنيف التعريفة والمنشأ.** غالبًا ما تعتمد الإعفاءات والأسعار على رمز التصنيف الدقيق وبلد المنشأ.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **تتبع أهلية الاسترداد.** احتفظ بسجلات الدخول وإثباتات الدفع والمواعيد النهائية لأي رسوم مدفوعة بموجب سلطة الطوارئ.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **التخطيط للتقلبات.** العقود التي تسمح بتعديلات الأسعار أو مشاركة مخاطر التعريفة تقلل من التعرض للتغيرات المفاجئة.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **تحدث إلى وسيط جمركي مرخص أو محامي تجاري** لاتخاذ القرارات ذات المخاطر المالية الكبيرة.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمتسوقين

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: التعريفات الجمركية هي ضرائب يدفعها المستوردون، وغالبًا ما يتم تمرير جزء من التكلفة في الأسعار.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: يعتمد المقدار على المنتج والمنافسة في السوق ومدة قدرة الشركات على استيعاب التكاليف.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: بعض النقاط العملية:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **قد لا تتحرك الأسعار دفعة واحدة.** غالبًا ما يحتفظ تجار التجزئة بالمخزون الذي تم شراؤه مسبقًا، لذا يمكن أن تظهر التغييرات مع تأخير.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **تختلف التأثيرات حسب الفئة.** تميل السلع التي يتم استيرادها بكثافة ولديها بدائل محلية قليلة إلى أن تكون أكثر حساسية.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.

fr.title: Droits de douane après la décision : ce qui remplace les droits d'urgence et qui est exempté

segments.src: When the Supreme Court limited the use of emergency powers to impose sweeping tariffs, it did not end the U.S.
segments.tr: Lorsque la Cour suprême a limité l'utilisation des pouvoirs d'urgence pour imposer des droits de douane massifs, elle n'a pas mis fin au programme tarifaire

segments.src: tariff program.
segments.tr: des États-Unis.

segments.src: It changed the legal foundation underneath it.
segments.tr: Elle a modifié le fondement juridique sous-jacent.

segments.src: With a temporary 10% global tariff now expired, the administration is leaning on a different set of statutes, and it is also granting exemptions for certain goods, including some from Canada.
segments.tr: Alors qu'un droit de douane mondial temporaire de 10 % a maintenant expiré, l'administration s'appuie sur un autre ensemble de lois et accorde également des exemptions pour certains biens, y compris certains en provenance du Canada.

segments.src: This explainer walks through the tools now in play, what each can and cannot do, and what importers and shoppers should watch.
segments.tr: Cette note explicative passe en revue les outils désormais en jeu, ce que chacun peut et ne peut pas faire, et ce que les importateurs et les acheteurs doivent surveiller.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not legal, trade or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale et ne constitue pas un avis juridique, commercial ou financier.

segments.src: Tariff rules change often, so check official sources for current rates.*
segments.tr: Les règles douanières changent souvent, veuillez donc consulter les sources officielles pour connaître les taux actuels.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **La voie des pouvoirs d'urgence a été restreinte.** La décision de la Cour a limité l'utilisation de la loi sur les pouvoirs économiques d'urgence internationale (IEEPA) comme base pour de larges droits de douane.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **Une mesure provisoire est apparue puis a disparu.** Un droit de douane mondial temporaire pouvant aller jusqu'à 10 % a servi de pont. De telles mesures comportent une limite de temps inhérente, et celle-ci a maintenant expiré.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **D'autres lois prennent le relai.** Les droits de douane se tournent vers des autorités qui exigent des enquêtes, des conclusions ou des conditions spécifiques.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **Les exemptions se multiplient.** Certains biens, y compris certains produits canadiens, sont exclus.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **Les remboursements et les règles restent incertains.** Les questions concernant les droits déjà payés et les nouvelles mesures suivent toujours leur cours auprès des agences et des tribunaux.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la décision était importante

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: L'IEEPA permet à un président de réglementer le commerce lors d'une urgence nationale déclarée.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: Elle avait été utilisée pour justifier des droits de douane larges et rapides sur de nombreux partenaires commerciaux.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: Le litige juridique portait sur la question de savoir si le mot "réglementer" dans cette loi inclut le pouvoir de taxer les importations, un pouvoir que la Constitution confère au Congrès.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: En limitant cette interprétation, la Cour a supprimé l'outil le plus rapide et a poussé le pouvoir exécutif vers des lois qui impliquent davantage de procédures et de limites.

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## Le pont : un droit de douane mondial temporaire

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: L'article 122 de la loi sur le commerce de 1974 (Trade Act of 1974) permet une surtaxe à l'importation temporaire à l'échelle générale pour faire face à de graves problèmes de balance des paiements.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: Deux caractéristiques le définissent :

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Un plafond de taux.** La surtaxe ne peut dépasser 15 %, et l'administration a appliqué un taux de 10 %.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **Une limite de temps.** Elle dure 150 jours à moins que le Congrès ne vote sa prolongation.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: Étant donné que cet outil est conçu pour être de courte durée, il a fonctionné comme un pont plutôt que comme une réponse permanente.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: Son expiration est la raison pour laquelle l'attention s'est tournée vers les remplacements ci-dessous.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## Les outils qui portent désormais le programme

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### Section 232 : sécurité nationale

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: La section 232 de la loi sur l'expansion du commerce de 1962 (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) permet au ministère du Commerce d'enquêter pour savoir si les importations d'un produit menacent la sécurité nationale.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: S'il constate une menace, le président peut imposer des droits de douane sur ce produit.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: L'acier, l'aluminium et les automobiles sont concernés depuis longtemps, et d'autres secteurs ont été examinés.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: Les tribunaux ont généralement accordé une grande marge de manœuvre au pouvoir exécutif en vertu de cette loi.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: Sa limite réside dans le fait qu'elle fonctionne produit par produit, après une enquête, plutôt que comme un tarif global à l'échelle du pays.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### Section 301 : pratiques commerciales déloyales

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: La section 301 de la loi sur le commerce de 1974 (Trade Act of 1974) permet au représentant au Commerce des

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: États-Unis d'enquêter sur les pratiques d'un pays étranger et d'y répondre par des droits de douane.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: Elle sous-tend les droits existants sur de nombreux produits chinois.

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: Elle exige un processus comprenant des conclusions, des commentaires publics et des audiences, ce qui la rend plus lente qu'une action d'urgence, mais plus défendable en justice.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: De nouvelles enquêtes nationales ou élargies sont un moyen pour l'administration de rétablir une couverture plus large.

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### Section 201 : mesures de sauvegarde

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: La section 201 permet un secours temporaire lorsqu'une hausse des importations nuit gravement à une industrie nationale.

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: Elle nécessite des conclusions de la Commission du commerce international des

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: États-Unis et sa durée est limitée.

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: Elle a été beaucoup moins utilisée, mais elle reste disponible.

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### Section 338 : une option rarement utilisée

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: La section 338 de la loi tarifaire de 1930 (Tariff Act of 1930) permet des droits additionnels sur les pays reconnus coupables de discriminer le commerce

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: des États-Unis.

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: Elle n'a jamais été utilisée de manière soutenue, et sa portée ainsi que sa durabilité juridique n'ont pas été testées.

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: Les analystes en parlent principalement comme d'une possibilité, et non comme d'une voie établie.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### Le Congrès

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: Le Congrès peut fixer ou prolonger les droits de douane directement, y compris en prolongeant une surtaxe temporaire.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: C'est la voie la plus sûre sur le plan juridique mais la plus difficile sur le plan politique, c'est pourquoi le pouvoir exécutif a privilégié ses propres autorités.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## Qui est exempté et pourquoi les exemptions se multiplient

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: Les exemptions sont une caractéristique normale de la politique tarifaire.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: Elles ont tendance à apparaître lorsque les droits augmentent les coûts pour les consommateurs ou les industries que le gouvernement souhaite protéger des chocs de prix.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: Les exclusions actuelles comprennent :

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **Certains biens canadiens.** Certains produits en provenance du Canada sont exemptés, ce qui reflète les chaînes d'approvisionnement profondément intégrées entre les deux pays, en particulier dans l'automobile, l'énergie et l'agriculture. Les biens admissibles en vertu de l'Accord États-Unis-Mexique-Canada (AEUMC) ont fait l'objet d'un traitement spécial lors des cycles précédents.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **Exclusions spécifiques aux produits.** Des articles tels que certains produits énergétiques, les produits pharmaceutiques et certains intrants essentiels ont été traités différemment lors de précédentes actions tarifaires.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Exclusions fondées sur les processus.** Certains programmes permettent aux importateurs de demander des exclusions pour des produits spécifiques lorsqu'ils peuvent prouver que l'approvisionnement n'est pas disponible ailleurs.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: Les listes d'exemption sont publiées dans des avis officiels et peuvent changer rapidement.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: Les codes de produits exacts et les conditions ont beaucoup d'importance, de sorte que la classification tarifaire d'un produit est la première chose à vérifier.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## Ce qui pourrait encore changer

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **Nouvelles enquêtes.** Chaque dossier de la section 232 ou 301 peut ajouter ou ajuster des droits sur des produits ou des pays spécifiques.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **Remboursements pour les droits déjà payés.** Les importateurs qui ont payé des droits en vertu du pouvoir d'urgence se demandent comment et quand les remboursements seront traités. Le calendrier et la procédure dépendent des décisions de justice et des directives des agences, et le résultat n'est pas garanti pour chaque importateur.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Nouveaux litiges.** Des contestations des autorités de remplacement sont possibles, bien que les tribunaux aient historiquement été plus indulgents en matière de droits de douane liés à la sécurité nationale.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **Accords commerciaux.** Des accords négociés avec des partenaires peuvent abaisser ou plafonner les taux et peuvent déterminer quels biens sont exemptés.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **Action du Congrès.** Une législation pourrait confirmer, limiter ou remplacer l'approche actuelle.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les importateurs

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Confirmer le fondement juridique de chaque expédition.** Les droits dépendent désormais davantage du produit et de la loi que d'un taux unique à l'échelle du pays.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **Examiner la classification tarifaire et l'origine.** Les exemptions et les taux dépendent souvent du code de classification exact et du pays d'origine.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **Suivre l'admissibilité au remboursement.** Conserver les dossiers d'entrée, les justificatifs de paiement et les délais pour tous les droits payés en vertu du pouvoir d'urgence.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **Prévoir la volatilité.** Les contrats qui permettent des ajustements de prix ou partagent le risque tarifaire réduisent l'exposition aux changements soudains.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **Consulter un courtier en douane agréé ou un avocat spécialisé dans le commerce** pour les décisions ayant des enjeux financiers importants.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les acheteurs

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: Les droits de douane sont des taxes payées par les importateurs, et une partie du coût est souvent répercutée sur les prix.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: Le montant dépend du produit, de la concurrence sur le marché et de la capacité des entreprises à absorber les coûts.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: Quelques points pratiques :

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Les prix peuvent ne pas bouger tous en même temps.** Les détaillants détiennent souvent des stocks achetés plus tôt, de sorte que les changements peuvent apparaître avec un décalage.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **Les effets varient selon la catégorie.** Les biens qui sont fortement importés et qui ont peu de substituts nationaux ont tendance à être plus sensibles.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Les exemptions peuvent atténuer l'impact** pour les produits couverts par des exclusions, mais tous les articles d'une catégorie ne sont pas admissibles.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **Être prudent quant aux déclarations.** Les gros titres citent souvent des taux maximaux, tandis que le montant réellement payé dépend du produit, de l'origine et des exemptions.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: La décision a fermé une voie juridique mais n'a pas mis fin aux droits de douane.

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: Le programme passe de mesures d'urgence rapides et générales à des outils plus lents et plus ciblés qui reposent sur des enquêtes et des conclusions légales.

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: Pour les entreprises et les consommateurs, le résultat pratique est une plus grande complexité : des taux et des exemptions qui dépendent du produit spécifique et de son origine, et un contexte politique qui peut encore évoluer par de nouvelles enquêtes, des décisions de justice et des négociations commerciales.

segments.tr: A Seção 122 da Lei de Comércio de 1974 permite uma sobretaxa de importação temporária geral para lidar com sérios problemas de balanço de pagamentos.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: Duas características a definem:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Um teto de taxa.** A sobretaxa não pode exceder 15%, e a administração usou uma taxa de 10%.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **Um limite de tempo.** Ela dura 150 dias, a menos que o Congresso vote para estendê-la.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: Como esta ferramenta foi desenhada para ser de curta duração, ela funcionou como uma ponte em vez de uma resposta permanente.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: Suaexpiração é o motivo pelo qual a atenção se voltou para as substituições abaixo.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## As ferramentas que agora sustentam o programa

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### Seção 232: segurança nacional

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: A Seção 232 da Lei de Expansão do Comércio de 1962 permite que o Departamento de Comércio investigue se as importações de um produto ameaçam a segurança nacional.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: Se encontrar uma ameaça, o presidente pode impor tarifas sobre esse produto.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: Aço, alumínio e automóveis têm sido cobertos há muito tempo, e outros setores foram examinados.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: Os tribunais geralmente têm dado ampla margem ao poder executivo sob esta lei.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: Sua limitação é que ela funciona produto por produto, após uma investigação, em vez de como uma tarifa abrangente em todo o país.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### Seção 301: práticas comerciais desleais

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
