segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: Ela exige um processo que inclui conclusões, consulta pública e audiências, portanto é mais lenta do que a ação de emergência, mas é mais defensável em tribunal.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: Novas investigações ou investigações ampliadas em nível de país são uma maneira de a administração reconstruir uma cobertura mais ampla.

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### Congresso

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: O Congresso pode definir ou estender tarifas diretamente, incluindo a extensão de uma sobretaxa temporária.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: Esta é a rota mais segura juridicamente, mas a mais difícil politicamente, razão pela qual o poder executivo tem favorecido suas próprias autoridades.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## Quem está isento e por que as isenções estão se expandindo

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: As isenções são uma característica normal da política tarifária.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: Elas tendem a aparecer quando os direitos aumentam os custos para consumidores ou indústrias que o governo deseja proteger de choques de preços.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: As exclusões atuais incluem:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **Certos produtos canadenses.** Alguns produtos do Canadá estão sendo isentos, refletindo as cadeias de suprimentos profundamente integradas entre os dois países, particularmente em automóveis, energia e agricultura. Bens que se qualificam sob o Acordo Estados Unidos-México-Canadá (USMCA) receberam tratamento especial em rodadas anteriores.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **Exclusões específicas de produtos.** Itens como alguns produtos de energia, produtos farmacêuticos e certos insumos críticos têm sido tratados de forma diferente em ações tarifárias passadas.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Exclusões baseadas em processos.** Alguns programas permitem que importadores solicitem exclusões para produtos específicos quando puderem mostrar que o suprimento não está disponível em outro lugar.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: As listas de isenção são publicadas em avisos oficiais e podem mudar rapidamente.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: Os códigos de produto exatos e as condições importam muito, portanto a classificação tarifária de um produto é a primeira coisa a ser verificada.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## O que ainda pode mudar

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **Novas investigações.** Cada caso da Seção 232 ou 301 pode adicionar ou ajustar direitos sobre produtos ou países específicos.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **Reembolsos por direitos já pagos.** Os importadores que pagaram direitos sob a autoridade de emergência estão perguntando como e quando os reembolsos serão processados. O cronograma e o procedimento dependem de ordens judiciais e orientações de agências, e o resultado não é garantido para todos os importadores.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Litígios adicionais.** Desafios às autoridades de substituição são possíveis, embora os tribunais historicamente tenham sido mais deferentes em relação a tarifas de segurança nacional.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **Acordos comerciais.** Acordos negociados com parceiros podem reduzir ou limitar taxas, e podem moldar quais bens estão isentos.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **Ação do Congresso.** A legislação pode confirmar, limitar ou substituir a abordagem atual.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para os importadores

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Confirme a base jurídica para cada remessa.** Os direitos agora dependem mais do produto e do estatuto do que de uma taxa única para todo o país.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **Revise a classificação tarifária e a origem.** Isenções e taxas frequentemente dependem do código de classificação exato e do país de origem.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **Rastreie a elegibilidade para reembolso.** Mantenha registros de entrada, comprovantes de pagamento e prazos para quaisquer direitos pagos sob a autoridade de emergência.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **Planeje-se para a volatilidade.** Contratos que permitem ajustes de preços ou compartilham o risco tarifário reduzem a exposição a mudanças repentinas.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **Converse com um despachante aduaneiro licenciado ou advogado comercial** para decisões com apostas financeiras significativas.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para os compradores

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: As tarifas são impostos pagos pelos importadores, e parte do custo é frequentemente repassada nos preços.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: Quanto depende do produto, da concorrência no mercado e de quanto tempo as empresas podem absorver os custos.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos práticos:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Os preços podem não mudar todos de uma vez.** Os varejistas frequentemente mantêm estoque comprado anteriormente, portanto as mudanças podem aparecer com atraso.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **Os efeitos variam por categoria.** Bens que são amplamente importados e têm poucos substitutos domésticos tendem a ser mais sensíveis.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **As isenções podem suavizar o impacto** para produtos cobertos por exclusões, mas nem todo item em uma categoria se qualifica.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **Tenha cautela com alegações.** As manchetes frequentemente citam taxas máximas, enquanto o valor realmente pago depende do produto, origem e isenções.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: A decisão fechou um caminho legal, mas não encerrou as tarifas.

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: O programa está se movendo de medidas de emergência rápidas e amplas para ferramentas mais lentas e direcionadas que se apoiam em investigações e conclusões estatutárias.

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: Para empresas e consumidores, o resultado prático é mais complexidade: taxas e isenções que dependem do produto específico e de sua origem, e um panorama de políticas que ainda pode mudar por meio de novas investigações, decisões judiciais e negociações comerciais.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Versi singkat

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Jalur wewenang darurat dipersempit.** Keputusan Pengadilan membatasi penggunaan Undang-Undang Kekuasaan Ekonomi Darurat Internasional (IEEPA) sebagai dasar untuk tarif luas.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **Jembatan sementara datang dan pergi.** Tarif global sementara hingga 10% digunakan sebagai jembatan. Langkah-langkah semacam itu memiliki batas waktu bawaan, dan yang ini kini telah kedaluwarsa.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **Undang-undang lain mengambil alih.** Tarif bergeser ke arah wewenang yang memerlukan investigasi, temuan, atau ketentuan khusus.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian semakin bertambah.** Beberapa barang, termasuk produk tertentu dari Kanada, sedang dikecualikan.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **Pengembalian dana dan aturan belum terselesaikan.** Pertanyaan tentang bea yang telah dibayarkan, dan tentang langkah-langkah baru, masih diproses melalui lembaga dan pengadilan.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: Hal itu telah digunakan untuk membenarkan tarif yang luas dan bergerak cepat pada banyak mitra dagang.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.

segments.tr: - **Barang-barang Kanada tertentu.** Beberapa produk dari Kanada dikecualikan, mencerminkan rantai pasokan yang sangat terintegrasi antara kedua negara, terutama dalam otomotif, energi, dan pertanian. Barang yang memenuhi syarat di bawah Perjanjian AS-Meksiko-Kanada (USMCA) telah menerima penanganan khusus di putaran sebelumnya.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian khusus produk.** Barang-barang seperti beberapa produk energi, farmasi, dan masukan penting tertentu telah diperlakukan secara berbeda dalam tindakan tarif masa lalu.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian berbasis proses.** Beberapa program memungkinkan importir untuk meminta pengecualian untuk produk tertentu ketika mereka dapat menunjukkan pasokan tidak tersedia di tempat lain.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: Daftar pengecualian diterbitkan dalam pemberitahuan resmi dan dapat berubah dengan cepat.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: Kode produk dan ketentuan yang tepat sangat penting, jadi klasifikasi tarif produk adalah hal pertama yang harus diverifikasi.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## Apa yang masih bisa berubah

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **Investigasi baru.** Setiap kasus Bagian 232 atau 301 dapat menambah atau menyesuaikan bea pada produk atau negara tertentu.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **Pengembalian dana untuk bea yang sudah dibayar.** Importir yang membayar bea di bawah wewenang darurat bertanya-tanya bagaimana dan kapan pengembalian dana akan diproses. Waktu dan prosedur bergantung pada perintah pengadilan dan panduan badan, dan hasilnya tidak dijamin untuk setiap importir.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Litigasi lebih lanjut.** Tantangan terhadap otoritas pengganti mungkin terjadi, meskipun pengadilan secara historis lebih menghormati tarif keamanan nasional.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **Perjanjian perdagangan.** Perjanjian yang negosiasikan dengan mitra dapat menurunkan atau membatasi tarif, dan dapat membentuk barang mana yang dikecualikan.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **Tindakan kongres.** Undang-undang dapat mengkonfirmasi, membatasi, atau menggantikan pendekatan saat ini.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi importir

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Konfirmasikan dasar hukum untuk setiap pengiriman.** Bea sekarang lebih bergantung pada produk dan undang-undang daripada pada satu tingkat seluruh negeri.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **Tinjau klasifikasi tarif dan asal.** Pengecualian dan tarif sering kali bergantung pada kode klasifikasi dan negara asal yang tepat.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **Lacak kelayakan pengembalian dana.** Simpan catatan entri, bukti pembayaran, dan batas waktu untuk bea apa pun yang dibayarkan di bawah wewenang darurat.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **Rencanakan volatilitas.** Kontrak yang memungkinkan penyesuaian harga atau berbagi risiko tarif mengurangi paparan terhadap perubahan mendadak.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **Bicaralah dengan pialang pabean berlisensi atau pengacara perdagangan** untuk keputusan dengan taruhan finansial yang signifikan.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi pembeli

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: Tarif adalah pajak yang dibayar oleh importir, dan beberapa biaya sering kali diteruskan ke dalam harga.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: Berapa banyak tergantung pada produk, persaingan di pasar, dan berapa lama perusahaan dapat menyerap biaya.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: Beberapa poin praktis:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Harga mungkin tidak bergerak sekaligus.** Pengecer sering memegang inventaris yang dibeli sebelumnya, sehingga perubahan dapat muncul dengan penundaan.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **Efek bervariasi menurut kategori.** Barang yang sangat diimpor dan memiliki sedikit pengganti domestik cenderung lebih sensitif.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian dapat melunakkan dampak** untuk produk yang dicakup oleh pengecualian, tetapi tidak setiap item dalam kategori memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **Berhati-hatilah terhadap klaim.** Berita utama sering kali mengutip tarif maksimum, sementara jumlah yang sebenarnya dibayarkan bergantung pada produk, asal, dan pengecualian.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: Keputusan itu menutup satu jalur hukum tetapi tidak mengakhiri tarif.

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: Program ini bergerak dari tindakan darurat yang cepat dan luas menuju alat yang lebih lambat dan lebih ditargetkan yang bergantung pada investigasi dan temuan undang-undang.

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: Untuk bisnis dan konsumen, hasil praktisnya adalah lebih banyak kompleksitas: tarif dan pengecualian yang bergantung pada produk tertentu dan asalnya, dan gambaran kebijakan yang masih dapat bergeser melalui investigasi baru, keputusan pengadilan, dan negosiasi perdagangan.

segments.src: The most reliable way to stay current is to follow official notices from U.S.
segments.tr: Cara paling andal untuk tetap mengikuti perkembangan adalah mengikuti pemberitahuan resmi dari

segments.tr: Perlindungan Bea dan Cukai A.S., Kantor

segments.tr: Perwakilan Dagang A.S., dan Departemen Perdagangan.

ja.title: 判決後の関税：緊急関税に代わるもの、そして免除対象とは

segments.src: When the Supreme Court limited the use of emergency powers to impose sweeping tariffs, it did not end the U.S.
segments.tr: 連邦最高裁判所が広範な関税を課すための緊急権限の使用を制限した際、それは米国の

segments.src: tariff program.
segments.tr: 関税プログラムを終わらせたわけではありません。

segments.src: It changed the legal foundation underneath it.
segments.tr: その法的基盤を変更したのです。

segments.src: With a temporary 10% global tariff now expired, the administration is leaning on a different set of statutes, and it is also granting exemptions for certain goods, including some from Canada.
segments.tr: 一時的な10%のグローバル関税が期限切れとなった今、政府は異なる一連の法令に依拠しており、カナダからのものを含む特定の物品に対して免除も認めています。

segments.src: This explainer walks through the tools now in play, what each can and cannot do, and what importers and shoppers should watch.
segments.tr: 本解説では、現在利用可能なツール、それぞれの機能と限界、そして輸入業者や消費者が注目すべき点について説明します。

segments.src: *This article is for general information and is not legal, trade or financial advice.
segments.tr: *本記事は一般的な情報提供を目的としており、法律、貿易、または財務に関する助言ではありません。

segments.src: Tariff rules change often, so check official sources for current rates.*
segments.tr: 関税規則は頻繁に変更されるため、最新の税率については公式情報源を確認してください。*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 要約

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **緊急権限によるルートは狭まりました。** 最高裁の判決により、広範な関税の根拠としての国際緊急経済権限法（IEEPA）の使用が制限されました。

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **暫定措置は終了しました。** 最大10%の一時的なグローバル関税が橋渡しとして使用されました。こうした措置には期限が設けられており、今回の措置はすでに失効しています。

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **他の法令が取って代わっています。** 関税は、調査、認定、または特定の条件を必要とする権限へと移行しています。

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **免除が拡大しています。** カナダ製品の一部を含む特定の物品が除外対象となっています。

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **還付と規則は未解決のままです。** すでに支払われた関税や新しい措置に関する疑問は、依然として各機関や裁判所で検討されています。

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## なぜこの判決が重要だったのか

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: IEEPAは、国家非常事態が宣言された際に大統領が通商を規制することを認めています。

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: これは、多くの貿易相手国に対する広範で迅速な関税を正当化するために使用されてきました。

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: この法的な論争は、同法における「規制」という言葉に、憲法が議会に与えている権限である輸入への課税権が含まれるかどうかに焦点が当てられました。

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: 最高裁はその解釈を制限することで、最も迅速なツールを取り除き、行政府をより多くの手続きと制限を含む法律へと向かわせました。

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## 橋渡し：一時的なグローバル関税

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: 1974年通商法第122条は、深刻な国際収支の問題に対処するため、一時的な一律の輸入課徴金を認めています。

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: これには2つの特徴があります：

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **税率の上限。** 課徴金は15%を超えることはできず、政府は10%の税率を使用しました。

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **期限。** 議会が延長を可決しない限り、150日間継続します。

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: このツールは短期間で終了するように設計されているため、恒久的な解決策ではなく、橋渡しとして機能しました。

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: その失効が、以下の代替措置に注目が集まっている理由です。

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## 現在プログラムを支えているツール

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### 第232条：国家安全保障

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: 1962年通商拡大法第232条は、商務省が特定の製品の輸入が国家安全保障を脅かすかどうかを調査することを認めています。

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: 脅威があると判断した場合、大統領はその製品に関税を課すことができます。

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: 鉄鋼、アルミニウム、自動車は長年対象となっており、他の分野も検討されてきました。

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: 裁判所は一般的に、この法律の下で行政府に広い裁量を与えてきました。

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: その限界は、国全体に対する包括的な関税ではなく、調査を経て製品ごとに機能する点にあります。

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### 第301条：不公正な貿易慣行

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: 1974年通商法第301条は、米国

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: 通商代表部が外国の慣行を調査し、関税で対応することを認めています。

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: これは、多くの中国製品に対する既存の関税の根拠となっています。

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: これには認定、パブリックコメント、公聴会を含むプロセスが必要であるため、緊急措置よりも遅いですが、裁判所ではより正当性が認められやすいものです。

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: 新規または拡大された国レベルの調査は、政府がより広範な適用範囲を再構築するための一つの方法です。

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### 第201条：セーフガード

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: 第201条は、輸入の急増が国内産業に深刻な損害を与える場合に、一時的な救済を認めています。

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: これには米国

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: 国際貿易委員会の認定が必要であり、期間が制限されています。

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: 使用頻度ははるかに低いですが、依然として利用可能です。

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### 第338条：めったに使用されない選択肢

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: 1930年関税法第338条は、米国

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: 通商に対して差別的であると判断された国に対する追加関税を認めています。

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: これは継続的に使用されたことはなく、その範囲や法的耐久性は検証されていません。

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: アナリストはこれを確立された道筋ではなく、主に可能性として議論しています。

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### 議会

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: 議会は、一時的な課徴金の延長を含め、直接関税を設定または延長することができます。

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: これは法的に最も確実なルートですが、政治的には最も困難であり、そのため行政府は独自の権限を優先してきました。

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## 免除対象は誰か、そしてなぜ免除が拡大しているのか

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: 免除は関税政策の通常の機能です。

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: 関税が消費者や政府が価格ショックから保護したい産業のコストを引き上げる場合に、免除が発生する傾向があります。

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: 現在の除外対象には以下が含まれます：

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **特定のカナダ製品。** カナダからの製品の一部は、特に自動車、エネルギー、農業における両国間の深く統合されたサプライチェーンを反映して、免除されています。米国・メキシコ・カナダ協定（USMCA）の下で資格のある物品は、以前のラウンドでも特別な扱いを受けてきました。

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **製品固有の除外。** 一部のエネルギー製品、医薬品、特定の重要な投入物などの品目は、過去の関税措置において異なる扱いを受けてきました。

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **プロセスに基づく除外。** 一部のプログラムでは、輸入業者が他の場所で供給を得られないことを証明できる場合、特定の製品の除外を申請することができます。

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: 免除リストは公式通知で公開されており、急速に変更される可能性があります。

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: 正確な製品コードと条件が非常に重要であるため、製品の関税分類を確認することが最初のステップです。

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## まだ変更される可能性があること

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **新規調査。** 第232条または第301条の各ケースにより、特定の製品や国に対する関税が追加または調整される可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **すでに支払われた関税の還付。** 緊急権限の下で関税を支払った輸入業者は、どのように、いつ還付が処理されるかを尋ねています。タイミングと手続きは裁判所の命令や各機関のガイダンスに依存しており、すべての輸入業者にとって結果が保証されているわけではありません。

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **さらなる訴訟。** 代替権限に対する異議申し立ては可能ですが、裁判所は歴史的に国家安全保障関税に対してより尊重する姿勢をとってきました。

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **貿易協定。** パートナーとの交渉による合意は、税率を引き下げたり上限を設けたりすることができ、どの物品が免除されるかを形作ることができます。

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **議会の行動。** 立法により、現在のアプローチを確認、制限、または置き換える可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## 輸入業者にとっての意味

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **各貨物の法的根拠を確認する。** 関税は現在、単一の国全体の税率よりも、製品と法令に依存しています。

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **関税分類と原産地を見直す。** 免除や税率は、正確な分類コードと原産国によって決まることがよくあります。

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **還付資格を追跡する。** 緊急権限の下で支払われた関税については、輸入記録、支払い証明、期限を保管してください。

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **変動に備える。** 価格調整を許可したり、関税リスクを共有したりする契約は、急激な変化への露出を減らします。

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers

de.title: Zölle nach dem Urteil: Was ersetzt die Notzölle und wer ist befreit?

segments.src: When the Supreme Court limited the use of emergency powers to impose sweeping tariffs, it did not end the U.S.
segments.tr: Als der Oberste Gerichtshof die Nutzung von Notstandsbefugnissen zur Erhebung umfassender Zölle einschränkte, beendete dies nicht das US-

segments.tr: Da ein vorübergehender globaler Zoll von 10 % nun ausgelaufen ist, stützt sich die Regierung auf eine andere Reihe von Gesetzen und gewährt zudem Ausnahmen für bestimmte Waren, einschließlich einiger aus Kanada.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Die Kurzfassung

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Der Weg über Notstandsbefugnisse wurde eingeschränkt.** Die Entscheidung des Gerichts begrenzte die Nutzung des International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) als Grundlage für umfassende Zölle.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **Ein Provisorium kam und ging.** Ein vorübergehender globaler Zoll von bis zu 10 % diente als Übergangslösung. Solche Maßnahmen haben eine eingebaute zeitliche Begrenzung, und diese ist nun abgelaufen.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **Andere Gesetze übernehmen.** Zölle verlagern sich hin zu Befugnissen, die Untersuchungen, Feststellungen oder spezifische Bedingungen erfordern.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **Ausnahmen nehmen zu.** Einige Waren, einschließlich bestimmter kanadischer Produkte, werden ausgenommen.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **Rückerstattungen und Regeln bleiben ungeklärt.** Fragen zu bereits gezahlten Zöllen und zu neuen Maßnahmen werden weiterhin von Behörden und Gerichten bearbeitet.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## Warum das Urteil wichtig war

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: Der IEEPA erlaubt es einem Präsidenten, den Handel während eines erklärten nationalen Notstands zu regulieren.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: Er wurde genutzt, um umfassende, schnell umgesetzte Zölle gegenüber vielen Handelspartnern zu rechtfertigen.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: Der Rechtsstreit drehte sich darum, ob das Wort "regulieren" in diesem Gesetz die Befugnis zur Besteuerung von Importen einschließt – eine Befugnis, die die Verfassung dem Kongress verleiht.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: Durch die Einschränkung dieser Auslegung entzog das Gericht der Exekutive das schnellste Instrument und drängte sie hin zu Gesetzen, die mehr Verfahren und mehr Beschränkungen vorsehen.

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## Die Brücke: ein vorübergehender globaler Zoll

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 122 des Handelsgesetzes von 1974 (Trade Act of 1974) erlaubt einen vorübergehenden allgemeinen Importzuschlag, um schwerwiegende Zahlungsbilanzprobleme anzugehen.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: Zwei Merkmale definieren ihn:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Eine Obergrenze für den Satz.** Der Zuschlag darf 15 % nicht überschreiten, und die Regierung nutzte einen Satz von 10 %.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **Eine zeitliche Begrenzung.** Er gilt für 150 Tage, es sei denn, der Kongress stimmt für eine Verlängerung.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: Da dieses Instrument auf kurze Dauer ausgelegt ist, fungierte es eher als Brücke denn als dauerhafte Lösung.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: Sein Auslaufen ist der Grund dafür, dass sich die Aufmerksamkeit auf die unten genannten Ersatzmaßnahmen richtet.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## Die Instrumente, die das Programm jetzt tragen

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### Abschnitt 232: nationale Sicherheit

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 232 des Handelsausweitungsgesetzes von 1962 (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) erlaubt es dem Handelsministerium zu untersuchen, ob Importe eines Produkts die nationale Sicherheit gefährden.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: Wenn es eine Bedrohung feststellt, kann der Präsident Zölle auf dieses Produkt erheben.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: Stahl, Aluminium und Autos sind seit langem betroffen, und andere Sektoren wurden ebenfalls geprüft.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: Gerichte haben der Exekutive unter diesem Gesetz im Allgemeinen großen Spielraum eingeräumt.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: Seine Einschränkung besteht darin, dass es produktbezogen nach einer Untersuchung funktioniert und nicht als pauschaler landesweiter Zoll.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### Abschnitt 301: unfaire Handelspraktiken

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 301 des Handelsgesetzes von 1974 erlaubt es dem US-

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: Handelsbeauftragten, die Praktiken eines fremden Landes zu untersuchen und mit Zöllen zu reagieren.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: Er bildet die Grundlage für die bestehenden Zölle auf viele chinesische Waren.

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: Er erfordert ein Verfahren, das Feststellungen, öffentliche Kommentare und Anhörungen umfasst; daher ist er langsamer als Notfallmaßnahmen, aber vor Gericht besser verteidigbar.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: Neue oder ausgeweitete Untersuchungen auf Länderebene sind eine Möglichkeit für die Regierung, eine breitere Abdeckung wiederherzustellen.

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### Abschnitt 201: Schutzmaßnahmen

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 201 erlaubt vorübergehende Entlastung, wenn ein Anstieg der Importe einer heimischen Industrie ernsthaft schadet.

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: Er erfordert eine Feststellung durch die US-

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: Internationale Handelskommission und ist zeitlich begrenzt.

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: Er wurde weitaus seltener genutzt, bleibt aber verfügbar.

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### Abschnitt 338: eine selten genutzte Option

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 338 des Zollgesetzes von 1930 (Tariff Act of 1930) erlaubt zusätzliche Zölle auf Länder, die den US-

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: Handel diskriminieren.

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: Er wurde noch nie nachhaltig eingesetzt, und sein Umfang sowie seine rechtliche Beständigkeit sind ungeprüft.

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: Analysten diskutieren ihn hauptsächlich als Möglichkeit, nicht als etablierten Weg.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### Kongress

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: Der Kongress kann Zölle direkt festlegen oder verlängern, einschließlich der Verlängerung eines vorübergehenden Zuschlags.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: Dies ist der rechtlich sicherste Weg, aber politisch der schwierigste, weshalb die Exekutive ihre eigenen Befugnisse bevorzugt hat.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## Wer ist befreit und warum nehmen Ausnahmen zu?

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: Ausnahmen sind ein normales Merkmal der Zollpolitik.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: Sie treten tendenziell auf, wenn Zölle die Kosten für Verbraucher oder Industrien erhöhen, die die Regierung vor Preisschocks schützen möchte.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: Zu den aktuellen Ausnahmeregelungen gehören:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **Bestimmte kanadische Waren.** Einige Produkte aus Kanada werden ausgenommen, was die tief integrierten Lieferketten zwischen den beiden Ländern widerspiegelt, insbesondere bei Autos, Energie und Landwirtschaft. Waren, die unter das Abkommen zwischen den USA, Mexiko und Kanada (USMCA) fallen, wurden in früheren Runden besonders behandelt.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **Produktspezifische Ausschlüsse.** Artikel wie einige Energieprodukte, Pharmazeutika und bestimmte kritische Vorleistungen wurden bei früheren Zollmaßnahmen unterschiedlich behandelt.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Verfahrensbasierte Ausschlüsse.** Einige Programme erlauben es Importeuren, Ausschlüsse für bestimmte Produkte zu beantragen, wenn sie nachweisen können, dass das Angebot anderswo nicht verfügbar ist.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: Ausnahmelisten werden in offiziellen Bekanntmachungen veröffentlicht und können sich schnell ändern.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: Die genauen Produktcodes und Bedingungen sind von großer Bedeutung, daher ist die zolltarifliche Einordnung eines Produkts das Erste, was überprüft werden muss.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## Was sich noch ändern könnte

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **Neue Untersuchungen.** Jeder Fall nach Abschnitt 232 oder 301 kann Zölle auf bestimmte Produkte oder Länder hinzufügen oder anpassen.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **Rückerstattungen für bereits gezahlte Zölle.** Importeure, die Zölle unter der Notstandsbefugnis gezahlt haben, fragen, wie und wann Rückerstattungen bearbeitet werden. Zeitplan und Verfahren hängen von Gerichtsbeschlüssen und behördlichen Leitlinien ab, und das Ergebnis ist nicht für jeden Importeur garantiert.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Weitere Rechtsstreitigkeiten.** Anfechtungen der Ersatzbefugnisse sind möglich, obwohl Gerichte bei Zöllen zur nationalen Sicherheit historisch gesehen zurückhaltender waren.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **Handelsabkommen.** Ausgehandelte Vereinbarungen mit Partnern können Sätze senken oder deckeln und beeinflussen, welche Waren ausgenommen sind.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **Maßnahmen des Kongresses.** Gesetzgebung könnte den aktuellen Ansatz bestätigen, begrenzen oder ersetzen.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## Was es für Importeure bedeutet

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Bestätigen Sie die Rechtsgrundlage für jede Sendung.** Zölle hängen jetzt stärker vom Produkt und dem Gesetz ab als von einem einheitlichen landesweiten Satz.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **Überprüfen Sie die zolltarifliche Einordnung und den Ursprung.** Ausnahmen und Sätze hängen oft vom genauen Klassifizierungscode und dem Ursprungsland ab.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **Verfolgen Sie die Anspruchsberechtigung auf Rückerstattung.** Bewahren Sie Einfuhrunterlagen, Zahlungsnachweise und Fristen für alle Zölle auf, die unter der Notstandsbefugnis gezahlt wurden.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **Planen Sie für Volatilität.** Verträge, die Preisanpassungen erlauben oder das Zollrisiko teilen, reduzieren die Anfälligkeit für plötzliche Änderungen.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **Sprechen Sie mit einem lizenzierten Zollagenten oder Handelsanwalt** bei Entscheidungen mit erheblichen finanziellen Auswirkungen.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Was es für Käufer bedeutet

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: Zölle sind Steuern, die von Importeuren gezahlt werden, und ein Teil der Kosten wird oft an die Preise weitergegeben.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: Wie viel, hängt vom Produkt, dem Wettbewerb auf dem Markt und der Dauer ab, wie lange Unternehmen Kosten absorbieren können.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: Einige praktische Punkte:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Preise ändern sich möglicherweise nicht sofort.** Einzelhändler halten oft früher gekaufte Lagerbestände, daher können sich Änderungen verzögert zeigen.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **Auswirkungen variieren je nach Kategorie.** Waren, die stark importiert werden und wenige inländische Substitute haben, sind tendenziell empfindlicher.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Ausnahmen können die Auswirkungen abmildern** für Produkte, die unter Ausnahmeregelungen fallen, aber nicht jeder Artikel in einer Kategorie qualifiziert sich.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **Seien Sie vorsichtig bei Behauptungen.** Schlagzeilen zitieren oft Höchstsätze, während der tatsächlich gezahlte Betrag vom Produkt, Ursprung und Ausnahmen abhängt.

segments.tr: Các quy tắc thuế quan thay đổi thường xuyên, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các nguồn chính thức để biết mức thuế hiện tại.*

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Phiên bản ngắn gọn

segments.src: - **The emergency-powers route was narrowed.** The Court's decision constrained the use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as a basis for broad tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Con đường quyền lực khẩn cấp đã bị thu hẹp.** Quyết định của Tòa án đã hạn chế việc sử dụng Đạo luật Quyền lực Kinh tế Khẩn cấp Quốc tế (IEEPA) làm cơ sở cho các biện pháp thuế quan diện rộng.

segments.src: - **A stopgap came and went.** A temporary global tariff of up to 10% was used as a bridge. Such measures carry a built-in time limit, and this one has now lapsed.
segments.tr: - **Một giải pháp tình thế đã đến và đi.** Một mức thuế toàn cầu tạm thời lên tới 10% đã được sử dụng làm cầu nối. Các biện pháp như vậy mang thời hạn tích hợp sẵn, và biện pháp này nay đã hết hạn.

segments.src: - **Other statutes are taking over.** Tariffs are shifting toward authorities that require investigations, findings or specific conditions.
segments.tr: - **Các quy chế khác đang tiếp quản.** Thuế quan đang chuyển dịch sang các cơ quan đòi hỏi phải có các cuộc điều tra, kết luận hoặc các điều kiện cụ thể.

segments.src: - **Exemptions are growing.** Some goods, including certain Canadian products, are being carved out.
segments.tr: - **Các trường hợp miễn trừ đang gia tăng.** Một số hàng hóa, bao gồm cả một số sản phẩm của Canada, đang được loại trừ.

segments.src: - **Refunds and rules remain unsettled.** Questions about duties already paid, and about new measures, are still moving through agencies and courts.
segments.tr: - **Việc hoàn tiền và các quy tắc vẫn chưa được giải quyết.** Các câu hỏi về các khoản thuế đã nộp, và về các biện pháp mới, vẫn đang được xem xét qua các cơ quan và tòa án.

segments.src: ## Why the ruling mattered
segments.tr: ## Tại sao phán quyết lại quan trọng

segments.src: IEEPA lets a president regulate commerce during a declared national emergency.
segments.tr: IEEPA cho phép tổng thống quản lý thương mại trong tình trạng khẩn cấp quốc gia được ban bố.

segments.src: It had been used to justify broad, fast-moving tariffs on many trading partners.
segments.tr: Nó đã được sử dụng để biện minh cho các mức thuế quan rộng rãi, diễn ra nhanh chóng đối với nhiều đối tác thương mại.

segments.src: The legal dispute turned on whether the word "regulate" in that law includes the power to tax imports, a power the Constitution gives to Congress.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp pháp lý xoay quanh việc liệu từ "quản lý" trong đạo luật đó có bao gồm quyền đánh thuế nhập khẩu hay không, một quyền mà Hiến pháp trao cho Quốc hội.

segments.src: By limiting that reading, the Court removed the quickest tool and pushed the executive branch toward laws that include more procedure and more limits.
segments.tr: Bằng cách hạn chế cách hiểu đó, Tòa án đã loại bỏ công cụ nhanh nhất và thúc đẩy nhánh hành pháp hướng tới các luật bao gồm nhiều thủ tục và nhiều giới hạn hơn.

segments.src: ## The bridge: a temporary global tariff
segments.tr: ## Cầu nối: thuế quan toàn cầu tạm thời

segments.src: Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 allows a temporary across-the-board import surcharge to address serious balance-of-payments problems.
segments.tr: Mục 122 của Đạo luật Thương mại năm 1974 cho phép áp dụng khoản phụ thu nhập khẩu tạm thời trên diện rộng để giải quyết các vấn đề trầm trọng về cán cân thanh toán.

segments.src: Two features define it:
segments.tr: Hai đặc điểm xác định nó:

segments.src: 1. **A rate cap.** The surcharge cannot exceed 15%, and the administration used a 10% rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Mức trần thuế suất.** Khoản phụ thu không được vượt quá 15% và chính quyền đã áp dụng mức 10%.

segments.src: 2. **A time limit.** It lasts 150 days unless Congress votes to extend it.
segments.tr: 2. **Thời hạn.** Nó kéo dài 150 ngày trừ khi Quốc hội bỏ phiếu gia hạn.

segments.src: Because this tool is designed to be short-lived, it worked as a bridge rather than a permanent answer.
segments.tr: Vì công cụ này được thiết kế để tồn tại trong thời gian ngắn, nó hoạt động như một cầu nối hơn là một câu trả lời vĩnh viễn.

segments.src: Its expiry is the reason attention has turned to the replacements below.
segments.tr: Việc hết hạn của nó là lý do tại sao sự chú ý đã chuyển sang các giải pháp thay thế dưới đây.

segments.src: ## The tools now carrying the program
segments.tr: ## Các công cụ hiện đang thực hiện chương trình

segments.src: ### Section 232: national security
segments.tr: ### Mục 232: an ninh quốc gia

segments.src: Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 lets the Commerce Department investigate whether imports of a product threaten national security.
segments.tr: Mục 232 của Đạo luật Mở rộng Thương mại năm 1962 cho phép Bộ Thương mại điều tra xem liệu việc nhập khẩu một sản phẩm có đe dọa an ninh quốc gia hay không.

segments.src: If it finds a threat, the president can impose tariffs on that product.
segments.tr: Nếu phát hiện ra mối đe dọa, tổng thống có thể áp thuế đối với sản phẩm đó.

segments.src: Steel, aluminum and autos have long been covered, and other sectors have been examined.
segments.tr: Thép, nhôm và ô tô từ lâu đã được bao phủ, và các lĩnh vực khác đã được xem xét.

segments.src: Courts have generally given the executive branch wide room under this law.
segments.tr: Các tòa án nhìn chung đã trao cho nhánh hành pháp không gian rộng rãi theo luật này.

segments.src: Its limitation is that it works product by product, after an investigation, rather than as a blanket country-wide tariff.
segments.tr: Hạn chế của nó là nó hoạt động theo từng sản phẩm, sau một cuộc điều tra, chứ không phải là một mức thuế toàn quốc bao trùm.

segments.src: ### Section 301: unfair trade practices
segments.tr: ### Mục 301: thực tiễn thương mại không công bằng

segments.src: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 lets the U.S.
segments.tr: Mục 301 của Đạo luật Thương mại năm 1974 cho phép Đại diện

segments.src: Trade Representative investigate a foreign country's practices and respond with tariffs.
segments.tr: Thương mại Hoa Kỳ điều tra các hành vi của nước ngoài và phản ứng bằng các biện pháp thuế quan.

segments.src: It underpins the existing duties on many Chinese goods.
segments.tr: Nó làm nền tảng cho các nhiệm vụ hiện có đối với nhiều hàng hóa Trung Quốc.

segments.src: It requires a process that includes findings, public comment and hearings, so it is slower than emergency action, but it is more defensible in court.
segments.tr: Nó đòi hỏi một quá trình bao gồm các kết luận, ý kiến đóng góp của công chúng và các phiên điều trần, do đó nó chậm hơn hành động khẩn cấp, nhưng nó có thể biện minh tốt hơn trước tòa.

segments.src: New or expanded country-level investigations are one way the administration can rebuild broader coverage.
segments.tr: Các cuộc điều tra cấp quốc gia mới hoặc mở rộng là một cách để chính quyền có thể xây dựng lại phạm vi bao phủ rộng hơn.

segments.src: ### Section 201: safeguards
segments.tr: ### Mục 201: các biện pháp tự vệ

segments.src: Section 201 allows temporary relief when a surge in imports seriously injures a domestic industry.
segments.tr: Mục 201 cho phép cứu trợ tạm thời khi sự gia tăng đột biến về nhập khẩu gây tổn hại nghiêm trọng cho ngành công nghiệp trong nước.

segments.src: It requires a finding by the U.S.
segments.tr: Nó đòi hỏi một kết luận từ Ủy ban

segments.src: International Trade Commission and is limited in duration.
segments.tr: Thương mại Quốc tế Hoa Kỳ và bị giới hạn về thời gian.

segments.src: It has been used far less often, but it remains available.
segments.tr: Nó ít được sử dụng hơn nhiều, nhưng nó vẫn khả dụng.

segments.src: ### Section 338: a rarely used option
segments.tr: ### Mục 338: một lựa chọn ít khi được sử dụng

segments.src: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows additional duties on countries found to discriminate against U.S.
segments.tr: Mục 338 của Đạo luật Thuế quan năm 1930 cho phép áp dụng các khoản thuế bổ sung đối với các quốc gia bị phát hiện phân biệt đối xử với thương mại

segments.src: commerce.
segments.tr: của Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: It has never been used in a sustained way, and its scope and legal durability are untested.
segments.tr: Nó chưa bao giờ được sử dụng một cách bền vững, và phạm vi cũng như độ bền vững pháp lý của nó vẫn chưa được kiểm chứng.

segments.src: Analysts discuss it mainly as a possibility, not an established path.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích thảo luận về nó chủ yếu như một khả năng, chứ không phải là một con đường đã được thiết lập.

segments.src: ### Congress
segments.tr: ### Quốc hội

segments.src: Congress can set or extend tariffs directly, including extending a temporary surcharge.
segments.tr: Quốc hội có thể thiết lập hoặc gia hạn thuế quan trực tiếp, bao gồm cả việc gia hạn phụ thu tạm thời.

segments.src: This is the most legally secure route but the hardest politically, which is why the executive branch has favored its own authorities.
segments.tr: Đây là con đường an toàn nhất về mặt pháp lý nhưng khó khăn nhất về mặt chính trị, đó là lý do tại sao nhánh hành pháp đã ưu tiên các thẩm quyền của chính mình.

segments.src: ## Who is exempt, and why exemptions are expanding
segments.tr: ## Ai được miễn trừ, và tại sao các trường hợp miễn trừ đang mở rộng

segments.src: Exemptions are a normal feature of tariff policy.
segments.tr: Miễn trừ là một đặc điểm bình thường của chính sách thuế quan.

segments.src: They tend to appear when duties raise costs for consumers or industries that the government wants to protect from price shocks.
segments.tr: Chúng có xu hướng xuất hiện khi các khoản thuế làm tăng chi phí cho người tiêu dùng hoặc các ngành công nghiệp mà chính phủ muốn bảo vệ khỏi những cú sốc giá cả.

segments.src: Current carve-outs include:
segments.tr: Các điều khoản loại trừ hiện tại bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Certain Canadian goods.** Some products from Canada are being exempted, reflecting the deeply integrated supply chains between the two countries, particularly in autos, energy and agriculture. Goods that qualify under the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) have received special handling in earlier rounds.
segments.tr: - **Một số hàng hóa Canada nhất định.** Một số sản phẩm từ Canada đang được miễn trừ, phản ánh chuỗi cung ứng được tích hợp sâu sắc giữa hai quốc gia, đặc biệt là trong lĩnh vực ô tô, năng lượng và nông nghiệp. Hàng hóa đủ điều kiện theo Hiệp định Hoa Kỳ-Mexico-Canada (USMCA) đã nhận được sự xử lý đặc biệt trong các vòng trước.

segments.src: - **Product-specific exclusions.** Items such as some energy products, pharmaceuticals, and certain critical inputs have been treated differently in past tariff actions.
segments.tr: - **Các ngoại lệ cụ thể theo sản phẩm.** Các mặt hàng như một số sản phẩm năng lượng, dược phẩm và một số yếu tố đầu vào quan trọng đã được đối xử khác biệt trong các hành động thuế quan trước đây.

segments.src: - **Process-based exclusions.** Some programs allow importers to request exclusions for specific products when they can show supply is not available elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Các ngoại lệ dựa trên quy trình.** Một số chương trình cho phép các nhà nhập khẩu yêu cầu ngoại lệ đối với các sản phẩm cụ thể khi họ có thể chứng minh nguồn cung không có sẵn ở nơi khác.

segments.src: Exemption lists are published in official notices and can change quickly.
segments.tr: Danh sách miễn trừ được công bố trong các thông báo chính thức và có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng.

segments.src: The exact product codes and conditions matter a great deal, so a product's tariff classification is the first thing to verify.
segments.tr: Mã sản phẩm chính xác và các điều kiện đóng vai trò rất quan trọng, vì vậy việc phân loại thuế quan của sản phẩm là điều đầu tiên cần xác minh.

segments.src: ## What could still change
segments.tr: ## Những gì vẫn có thể thay đổi

segments.src: - **New investigations.** Each Section 232 or 301 case can add or adjust duties on specific products or countries.
segments.tr: - **Các cuộc điều tra mới.** Mỗi vụ việc theo Mục 232 hoặc 301 có thể bổ sung hoặc điều chỉnh các khoản thuế đối với các sản phẩm hoặc quốc gia cụ thể.

segments.src: - **Refunds for duties already paid.** Importers who paid duties under the emergency authority are asking how and when refunds will be processed. Timing and procedure depend on court orders and agency guidance, and the outcome is not guaranteed for every importer.
segments.tr: - **Hoàn tiền cho các khoản thuế đã nộp.** Các nhà nhập khẩu đã nộp thuế theo quyền lực khẩn cấp đang đặt câu hỏi về cách thức và thời điểm hoàn tiền sẽ được xử lý. Thời gian và thủ tục phụ thuộc vào lệnh của tòa án và hướng dẫn của cơ quan, và kết quả không được đảm bảo cho mọi nhà nhập khẩu.

segments.src: - **Further litigation.** Challenges to the replacement authorities are possible, though courts have historically been more deferential on national-security tariffs.
segments.tr: - **Tranh tụng tiếp theo.** Những thách thức đối với các cơ quan thay thế là có thể xảy ra, mặc dù các tòa án trước đây tỏ ra tôn trọng hơn đối với thuế quan an ninh quốc gia.

segments.src: - **Trade deals.** Negotiated agreements with partners can lower or cap rates, and can shape which goods are exempt.
segments.tr: - **Các thỏa thuận thương mại.** Các thỏa thuận được đàm phán với các đối tác có thể hạ thấp hoặc giới hạn mức thuế, và có thể định hình hàng hóa nào được miễn trừ.

segments.src: - **Congressional action.** Legislation could confirm, limit or replace the current approach.
segments.tr: - **Hành động của Quốc hội.** Luật pháp có thể xác nhận, hạn chế hoặc thay thế cách tiếp cận hiện tại.

segments.src: ## What it means for importers
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với các nhà nhập khẩu

segments.src: 1. **Confirm the legal basis for each shipment.** Duties now depend more on the product and the statute than on a single country-wide rate.
segments.tr: 1. **Xác nhận cơ sở pháp lý cho từng lô hàng.** Thuế bây giờ phụ thuộc nhiều hơn vào sản phẩm và quy chế hơn là một mức thuế toàn quốc duy nhất.

segments.src: 2. **Review tariff classification and origin.** Exemptions and rates often turn on the exact classification code and country of origin.
segments.tr: 2. **Xem xét phân loại thuế quan và nguồn gốc.** Các trường hợp miễn trừ và mức thuế thường xoay quanh mã phân loại chính xác và quốc gia xuất xứ.

segments.src: 3. **Track refund eligibility.** Keep entry records, payment proofs and deadlines for any duties paid under the emergency authority.
segments.tr: 3. **Theo dõi tính đủ điều kiện được hoàn tiền.** Giữ lại hồ sơ nhập cảnh, bằng chứng thanh toán và thời hạn cho bất kỳ khoản thuế nào đã nộp theo quyền lực khẩn cấp.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for volatility.** Contracts that allow price adjustments or share tariff risk reduce exposure to sudden changes.
segments.tr: 4. **Lập kế hoạch cho sự biến động.** Các hợp đồng cho phép điều chỉnh giá hoặc chia sẻ rủi ro thuế quan làm giảm sự tiếp xúc với những thay đổi đột ngột.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to a licensed customs broker or trade attorney** for decisions with significant financial stakes.
segments.tr: 5. **Nói chuyện với một nhà môi giới hải quan được cấp phép hoặc luật sư thương mại** cho các quyết định có cổ phần tài chính đáng kể.

segments.src: ## What it means for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với người mua sắm

segments.src: Tariffs are taxes paid by importers, and some of the cost is often passed along in prices.
segments.tr: Thuế quan là các loại thuế do các nhà nhập khẩu nộp, và một phần chi phí thường được chuyển vào giá cả.

segments.src: How much depends on the product, the competition in the market, and how long companies can absorb costs.
segments.tr: Mức độ phụ thuộc vào sản phẩm, sự cạnh tranh trên thị trường và thời gian các công ty có thể hấp thụ chi phí.

segments.src: A few practical points:
segments.tr: Một số điểm thực tế:

segments.src: - **Prices may not move all at once.** Retailers often hold inventory bought earlier, so changes can show up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Giá có thể không thay đổi cùng một lúc.** Các nhà bán lẻ thường giữ hàng tồn kho mua trước đó, vì vậy các thay đổi có thể xuất hiện với độ trễ.

segments.src: - **Effects vary by category.** Goods that are heavily imported and have few domestic substitutes tend to be more sensitive.
segments.tr: - **Hiệu ứng thay đổi theo danh mục.** Hàng hóa được nhập khẩu nhiều và có ít sản phẩm thay thế trong nước có xu hướng nhạy cảm hơn.

segments.src: - **Exemptions can soften the impact** for products covered by carve-outs, but not every item in a category qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Các trường hợp miễn trừ có thể làm dịu tác động** đối với các sản phẩm nằm trong diện được cắt giảm, nhưng không phải mọi mặt hàng trong một danh mục đều đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: - **Be cautious about claims.** Headlines often cite maximum rates, while the amount actually paid depends on product, origin and exemptions.
segments.tr: - **Cẩn thận với các tuyên bố.** Các tiêu đề thường trích dẫn mức tối đa, trong khi số tiền thực tế được trả phụ thuộc vào sản phẩm, nguồn gốc và các trường hợp miễn trừ.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The ruling closed one legal path but did not end tariffs.
segments.tr: Phán quyết đã đóng một con đường pháp lý nhưng không chấm dứt thuế quan.

segments.src: The program is moving from fast, broad emergency measures toward slower, more targeted tools that rest on investigations and statutory findings.
segments.tr: Chương trình đang chuyển từ các biện pháp khẩn cấp nhanh chóng, rộng rãi sang các công cụ chậm hơn, có mục tiêu hơn dựa trên các cuộc điều tra và phát hiện theo luật định.

segments.src: For businesses and consumers, the practical result is more complexity: rates and exemptions that depend on the specific product and its origin, and a policy picture that can still shift through new investigations, court decisions and trade negotiations.
segments.tr: Đối với các doanh nghiệp và người tiêu dùng, kết quả thực tế là phức tạp hơn: mức thuế và các trường hợp miễn trừ phụ thuộc vào sản phẩm cụ thể và nguồn gốc của nó, và một bức tranh chính sách vẫn có thể thay đổi thông qua các cuộc điều tra mới, quyết định của tòa án và các cuộc đàm phán thương mại.
